note: The chapter opening (P01 'CHAPTER 10', the title passage P02, figure P03 and the bridging sentence P04) has no heading in the supplied list (which starts at 10.1), so subtopic 1 carries from_heading 'unsure'. Section 10.1 is one long unsegmented block with no sub-headings, so its seven ideas (food-production options, tissue culture, somatic hybridisation, GMOs, Bt cotton, nematode resistance) were split by content rather than by heading number, and all six of those subtopics necessarily share the same from_heading. P33 begins mid-list at '(iii) Biological products', so items (i) and (ii) of the transgenic-animal uses list sit in the truncated tail of P32; both are kept in one subtopic. Figure passages P03, P16, P19, P24 have empty text and are placed with the text immediately preceding them. The summary passage P41 and exercise passage P42 span the chapter; P41 is attached to subtopic 1 and P42 to subtopics 1 and 3 (its visible questions are on virus-free plants and micropropagation).
